event.description:
GATCG MRC Store Championships @ Favonia Hobbies

Date/Time: 21 July 2024 | 2 P.M. (SUNDAY)
Check-In Time: 12PM
Location: Favonia Hobbies HQ Ipoh
Format: Swiss (BO3)
Deck Format: Standard Constructed 
Entry Fee: RM 60
Entry Prize: 2x Random GA Booster Pack + 1 ALC Silver Pack + 1 MRC Silver Pack + 1 MRC Gold Pack 

Ban list: https://www.gatcg.com/article/ban-and-restricted-announcement-june-10th-2024

Champion - 1x Champion Playmat + 1x Champion Promo + 1 Silvie Idle Thoughts Promo NF + 2x MRC Gold Packs + 3x Silver Packs + 4x GA Booster Packs

2nd - 1 Silvie Idle Thoughts Promo NF + 2x MRC Gold Packs + 3x Silver Packs + 3x GA Booster Packs 

3rd - 1 Silvie Idle Thoughts Promo NF + 2x MRC Gold Pack + 2x Silver Packs + 2 GA Booster Pack 

4th - 1x MRC Gold Pack + 3x Silver Packs + 2 GA Booster Packs

Lucky Draw (Base on outcome);-

- Silvie Idle Thoughts NF Promo
- MRC Gold and Silver Packs 
- ALC Gold and Silver Packs 
- FTC Gold and Silver Packs
- GA Booster Packs

* Minimum 10 Players to start
* Players are to be punctual and arrive 30 min before the start of the tournament
* Favonia Hobbies reserve the rights to change the prize structure without prior notice
